stem: An operator procedure permits one reset, but the fault returns immediately. What should happen next?
choices: Stop repeated resets, document the recurring condition and escalate under the servicing/maintenance pathway.
Repeat the reset until the equipment stays on.
Lower the setpoint so the fault does not trigger.
rationale: Stop repeated resets, document the recurring condition and escalate under the servicing/maintenance pathway. This preserves the evidence and role boundary required by the referenced verification framework.
